return.title: Returns & Refund Policy
return.subtitle: We aim to provide high-quality electronic components and a transparent buying experience. Please read the return and refund policy carefully before placing an order.
return.eligibilityDesc: Returns are accepted only under the following conditions:
return.eligibility1: The product received is damaged, defective, or incorrect
return.eligibility2: The issue is reported within 48 hours of delivery
return.eligibility3: The product is unused, unsoldered, and in original condition
return.eligibility4: Original packaging, labels, and accessories are intact
return.eligibilityWarning: Products that have been used, installed, soldered, altered, or physically damaged after delivery are not eligible for return.
return.nonReturnableDesc: The following items are not eligible for return or refund:
return.nonReturnable2: Items damaged due to improper handling or installation
return.nonReturnable3: Clearance or discounted products (if mentioned at purchase)
return.step2: Share your order ID, product details, and clear images or videos of the issue
return.step3: Our team will review the request and respond within 2 business days
return.approvalNote: Returns must be approved before shipping the product back.
return.refundPoint1: Once the returned product is received and inspected, we will notify you of the approval or rejection
return.refundPoint2: If approved, refunds will be processed within 5–7 business days
return.refundPoint3: Refunds will be credited to the original payment method
return.refundShippingNote: Shipping charges (if any) are non-refundable, unless the return is due to our error.
return.replacementDesc: In cases of damaged or defective products, we may offer a replacement instead of a refund, based on availability and customer preference.
return.returnShippingPoint1: If the return is due to a wrong or defective product, return shipping will be arranged or reimbursed by us
return.returnShippingPoint2: For other approved returns, the customer may be responsible for return shipping costs
return.importantNote1: Do not send products back without confirmation
return.importantNote2: We reserve the right to reject returns that do not meet the eligibility criteria
return.importantNote3: Refund timelines may vary based on banks or payment providers
return.needHelpDesc: For questions related to returns or refunds, contact:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: At RazorBills, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and share your information when you use our e-commerce platform for electronics and electronic components.
privacy.personalInfo1: Name, email address, and phone number
privacy.personalInfo3: Payment information (processed securely through encrypted channels)
privacy.usageInfo2: Website interaction data and browsing patterns
privacy.securityDesc: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data:
privacy.encryptionDesc: All sensitive data transmitted between your device and our servers is protected using end-to-end encryption. This ensures that your personal information, payment details, and communications remain secure during transmission.
privacy.backendDesc: Our ExpressJS backend implements robust security protocols, including data validation, secure authentication, and encrypted API communications to protect against unauthorized access.
privacy.firebaseDesc: We use Firebase as our database solution, which provides enterprise-grade security with automatic encryption at rest and in transit, secure authentication, and comprehensive security rules to protect your data.
privacy.useInfo1: Process and fulfill your orders and transactions
privacy.useInfo2: Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
privacy.useInfo3: Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and important account notifications
privacy.useInfo4: Personalize your shopping experience and product recommendations
privacy.useInfo5: Improve our website functionality and user experience
privacy.useInfo7: Comply with legal obligations and protect our legal rights
privacy.sharingDesc: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
privacy.sharing1: With trusted service providers who assist in operating our platform (payment processors, shipping companies)
privacy.sharing2: When required by law or to respond to legal process
privacy.sharing3: To protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users
privacy.sharing4: In connection with a business transfer or merger (with prior notice to users)
privacy.rightsDesc: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:
privacy.rightsAccessDesc: Request a copy of the personal information we have about you
privacy.rightsCorrectionDesc: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
privacy.rightsDeletionDesc: Request deletion of your personal information (subject to legal requirements)
privacy.rightsPortabilityDesc: Request transfer of your data to another service provider
privacy.rightsOptOutDesc: Unsubscribe from marketing communications at any time
privacy.rightsRestrictDesc: Request limitation on how we use your information
privacy.cookiesDesc: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience:
privacy.cookiesEssentialDesc: Required for website functionality and security
privacy.cookiesPerformanceDesc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website
privacy.cookiesMarketingDesc: Used to deliver relevant advertisements (with your consent)
privacy.cookiesManage: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or our cookie management tool.
privacy.retentionDesc: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements. Account information is typically retained while your account is active and for a reasonable period thereafter for legal and business purposes.
privacy.childrenDesc: RazorBills is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately, and we will delete such information from our systems.
privacy.transfersDesc: Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. These countries may have different data protection laws. When we transfer your information internationally, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your privacy and comply with applicable data protection laws.
privacy.updatesDesc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable laws. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our website and updating the "Last updated" date. Your continued use of our services after such changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.contactDesc: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:
privacy.commitment: We are committed to resolving any privacy-related concerns promptly and transparently.
privacy.footerNote: © {{year}} RazorBills. Your privacy is our priority.
